headline: Dhruv Consultancy provides Regulation 30 project update to the exchange
hook: Routine project progress filing from Dhruv
summary: Dhruv Consultancy Services Limited has submitted a project update to the stock exchange under Regulation 30 of SEBI LODR regulations. The filing provides routine operational disclosures regarding ongoing consultancy projects. For an Indian retail investor, this is standard compliance reporting that has no immediate material impact on the company's stock price or financial performance.
why_it_matters: Routine compliance filing with no direct financial impact

headline: Dhruv Consultancy Services announces board meeting outcome
hook: Routine board meeting update from Dhruv
summary: Dhruv Consultancy Services Limited has formally informed the stock exchange regarding the outcome of its board meeting held on October 12, 2026. Such routine disclosures are part of standard corporate governance filings required for listed entities. Indian retail investors tracking small-cap infrastructure consultancies should review the specific exchange filing for details on any corporate actions taken during the meeting.
why_it_matters: Check exchange filings for specific corporate decisions.
